//: Third-party tools of the workstation bootstrap bundle (03 §4.5), read by build/package.ts. session-manager-plugin is downloaded at boot from the official AWS download location (urlTemplate, the versioned path of the 'latest' URL in the AWS install guide) and installed only when its SHA-256 equals the pin. pin.version null = platform/ssm-client PROTOCOL_COMPAT_VERSION without hashes (the workstation then skips the plugin and says why). Pins are recorded by scripts/release-docker/pin-ssm-plugin.sh, which downloads the pinned version once on the maintainer machine; hashes are never guessed. `--ssm-plugin-sha256 <arch>=<hex>` (with --ssm-plugin-version) overrides the pin for one package run. k6 is optional: the experiments runner is the Node implementation (experiments/_lib/load.ts) and works without it; `--k6-tarball` still bundles it.
